goal.request: Strengthen visual-semantic data and candidate packs for five distinct humanlike-entity terms, then test prompt and pixel realization through five independent single-render arms using the supplied portrait as appearance inspiration.

evidence.claim: The five terms describe different origin, cellular-composition, scale-and-motility, synchronization, or living-synthetic relations, and several of those relations are not directly provable from appearance alone.
The supplied image provides a frontal adult portrait with long dark wavy hair and was authorized only as general facial-appearance inspiration for the generated scenes.
The five profiles, exact/advisory routing cases, gate ownership, indexes, dictionary metadata, and pre-pack contracts pass their focused validation suites.
evidence.artifact: python -m unittest tests.test_photo_humanlike_semantics tests.test_photo_visual_obligations tests.test_photo_visual_profile_retrieval tests.test_photo_bm25f_retrieval tests.test_photo_authorial_core_v5 tests.test_photo_authorial_core_v6 tests.test_photo_prepack_isolation_v5; visual-profile-index --check; dictionary validator

evidence.claim: Full discovery ran 782 tests and ended with 10 failures and 3 errors; every failing name reproduced on a clean archive of the starting revision, so no new full-suite failing name was introduced.
evidence.artifact: python -m unittest discover -s tests; clean git-archive baseline reruns recorded in coordinator-review.md

evidence.claim: All five independently composed prompts and all five exact runtime render requests passed fail-closed audits before generation, each with exactly one reference image.
Clone passed three of five hard gates; source-to-copy direction and exclusion of an ordinary-twin substitute remained ambiguous at thumbnail scale.
Chimera passed all five hard gates with coherent human anatomy and two scientifically labeled lineages integrated across the same projected organs.
Anthrobot passed all five hard gates with a physical-to-magnified scale bridge, multicellular texture, cilia, and experimental motility.
Human digital twin passed all five hard gates with distinct outbound live sensing and returned predictive updates linked to one physical referent.
Biohybrid robot passed four of five hard gates; living and synthetic materials coexist, but an unambiguous tissue-to-electrode force path or contraction-driven deformation is missing.
Across five one-call arms, prompt and runtime audits were 5/5 PASS, pixel gates were 22/25 PASS, and complete arm-level technical qualification was 3/5.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Each exact humanlike-entity term must produce its own observable component relation and confusion boundary at both native and thumbnail scales; a label or partial component set is insufficient.

invariants.statement: Clone, cellular chimera, Anthrobot, human digital twin, and biohybrid robot retain separate profiles and disjoint hard-gate ownership rather than collapsing into one generic near-human class.
Biological origin, cellular lineage, synchronization, and functional integration require contextual visual evidence and cannot pass from resemblance alone.
The supplied portrait controls only general facial-appearance inspiration and never establishes identity or biological sameness.

flexible_dimensions: phenotype variation that preserves the requested relation
scientific visualization style when all hard gates remain observable

mismatches.source_state: A biological clone needs one visually attributable source lineage and evidence that excludes ordinary twins or merely similar subjects.
mismatches.render_state: Two organic related-looking adults and genomic records are visible, but the source-versus-copy direction is not readable at thumbnail scale.

mismatches.source_state: The living tissue must visibly actuate or sense through a synthetic interface rather than merely sharing a shell.
mismatches.render_state: Tissue, ribs, shell, and cables coexist, but no electrode contact or contraction-driven fin deformation is unambiguous.

hypotheses.statement: Independent profiles with component evidence and false-substitute gates will route the five labels without ontology collapse or android-clone collision.
hypotheses.falsifier: An exact or component routing case activates the wrong profile, or two profiles share a hard-gate identifier.

hypotheses.statement: A single still-image generation more reliably renders static co-presence than directional provenance or causal material interfaces, even when the audited prompt contains the required relation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent one-call renders consistently show readable source-to-copy direction and visible tissue-driven deformation at thumbnail scale.

hypotheses.statement: One render per profile establishes case-level feasibility but cannot establish a robust per-profile success rate.
hypotheses.falsifier: A pre-registered repeated-sample evaluation provides stable confidence intervals for every profile.

intervention.general_rule: Represent each exact humanlike-entity term as a separate component-based visual obligation with contextual provenance, an explicit observability limit, and hard false-substitute gates; exact labels hard-activate while component-only descriptions remain advisory.
intervention.generalization_basis: The rule is derived from five terms spanning biological origin, cellular composition, microscopic living systems, bidirectional models, and living-synthetic machines, with multilingual positive, component, and negative routing cases.

decision.rationale: The structural and prompt layers are implemented and audited, but only three of five one-call arms passed every pixel gate. Clone provenance direction and biohybrid force transmission need stronger visual controls before any broad render-fidelity promotion; user aesthetic judgment is also still pending.
